02 / In the details

Quiet from the front.
Different from the back.

A small light emblem at the front. A larger tonal motif across the back. Two details with a different presence.

Black on black.
Depth in the detail.

The back emblem is embroidered in black thread. Its raised texture gives the mark definition as the light changes.

03 / Fit & sizing

Find your fit.

Available in XS, S, M and L. The silhouette is oversized, with room through the body and sleeves.

For exact garment measurements, ask us before choosing your size. We’ll help you compare the hoodie with one you already wear.

Ask for measurements ↗

Compare the garment, not your body.

Length
Shoulder to the bottom hem.
Width
Measured flat, under the armholes. This is not a body circumference.
Sleeve
Ask for the sleeve measurement and its starting point.

We’ll confirm the measurements for the size you’re considering.

04 / How it started

Made for myself.
Shared with others.

This hoodie began as something the founder wanted to wear. When people started asking about it, it became available to others.

A personal piece, now part of Spectre Apparel.

Before you order.

A direct conversation about your size and the details of your order.

Delivery

Based in Switzerland. Delivery is arranged by message. We confirm the shipping cost and dispatch date before you place an order; delivery is additional to the CHF 50 hoodie price.

Care

Some new pieces may shed dark fibres onto lighter clothing. Ask us for the care guidance before ordering so you know what to expect.

Returns & exchanges

Ask about sizing, exchanges and returns before confirming your order. If you have a problem with your hoodie, contact us directly.

Contact

For sizes, measurements or an order, email hello@spectre-studio.co. Instagram ordering will be linked here when the account is confirmed.
